notes.title: Rogue Sentry v1.3.0 Patch Notes: Japanese Language Support
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/eCUeIvW.png

Wow, it's already been a year since Rogue Sentry released on Itch, and Steam's one year release anniversary is not far off, either. I'm happy to announce that Rogue Sentry can now be played in Japanese. 日本語が読めますか？ 🤔

Changelog:


 Added Ghosts to the cast credits.
 Added language options to the settings.
 Added Japanese as a language option.

Thanks for all of the support. You can follow me for updates, hound me, and contact me @itsMaple. I am still accepting bug reports, including via support@mapledev.net.

I hope you're having fun and playing (or making!) some cool games out there. Take care and stay true.

Josh
Mapledev

notes.title: Rogue Sentry v1.2.0 Patch Notes: Mouse Controls Enabled
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! You can now play Rogue Sentry with WASD + Mouse to aim and fire! Mouse to move is also possible, if you want to play with one hand, die more often, or eat snacks with your other hand. Yum!

Changelog:


 Added mouse controls for aiming and movement.
 Added "Swap Move/Aim Keys" option to Keyboard Config menu.
 Moved the Controls menu item from the bottom of the Settings menu, to the top.
 Fixed softlock when repeatedly selecting "Respawn" from the pause menu.
 Fixed diagonal speed discrepancy between control options.
 Fixed ghosts spawning when powered gates are destroyed.
 Fixed ghosts spawning in ending cutscene.


This update was made possible by community suggestions and feedback. Thanks for sending them my way. I'm still making changes over time, so if you have any feedback, bug reports, or job offers, please let me know. You can do this in many ways, such as emailing support@mapledev.net or posting a comment. I'm also active on Twitter @itsMaple.

I hope you enjoy the summer sale. Don't go too broke!

- Josh
Mapledev

P.S. Quick! Watch speedruns as fast as possible and submit your own at https://www.speedrun.com/rogue_sentry!

notes.title: Rogue Sentry v1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who has been playing and enjoying Rogue Sentry! It's been really cool to engage with the community and see content pop up around the web. I've put together a small update to address some issues that you discovered - most notably non-Xbox controller button remapping and Steam screenshot functionality, so feel free to fix that map button and please share your screenshots with the community!

Changelog
Added ability to share screenshots via Steam.
Fixed inability to change button mappings for non-Xbox controllers.
Fixed typos: Romour -> Rumour, Is it -> It is, implimented -> implemented, self-distruct -> self-destruct.
Fixed Sentry Droid detecting player through seams in wall.
Fixed bad laser placement in North-West Quarter.
Fixed Turret heart not dropping if previously picked up.
Fixed 1-3 human Guard room continuity error.

I'll continue to fix issues over time. If you spot anything odd, please let me know. You can do this in many ways, such as emailing support@mapledev.net or posting in the Steam community. I'm also active on Twitter @itsMaple.

Stay safe, stay cool, and I'll catch you next time!

- Josh
Mapledev

P.S. Are you fast? Watch speedruns and submit your own at https://www.speedrun.com/rogue_sentry :)
